salt_concord.name: The Salt Concord
salt_concord.tagline: Order is the only thing between the Rim and the salt.

hadal_court.name: The Hadal Court
hadal_court.tagline: The sea was ours. We are coming up to collect it.

returning_tide.name: The Returning Tide
returning_tide.tagline: The sea is above us. Hurry it home.

salvage_compact.name: The Salvage Compact
salvage_compact.tagline: Everything on the floor belongs to whoever drags it off.

reef_ascendant.name: The Reef Ascendant
reef_ascendant.tagline: One mind. Ten thousand bodies. The first dawn is ours.

lanternkeepers.name: The Lanternkeepers
lanternkeepers.tagline: Keep the lamp lit. Say nothing.
